CREATE VIEW cross_border_compliance_gap_view AS
SELECT 
    df.recordregistry AS flow_id,
    df.orignation AS origin_country,
    df.destnation AS destination_country,
    df.origactor AS source_entity,
    df.destactor AS destination_entity,
    df.chanproto AS protocol,
    df.chanfreq AS frequency,
    df.datasizemb AS data_size_mb,
    df.durmin AS duration_minutes,
    df.bwidthpct AS bandwidth_utilization,
    df.successpct AS success_rate,
    df.errtally AS error_count,
    df.rtrytally AS retry_count,
    vm.vendassess AS vendor_assessment_status,
    vm.vendsecrate AS vendor_security_rating,
    vm.vendauddate AS vendor_last_audit_date,
    vm.contrstate AS contract_state,
    vm.contrexpire AS contract_expiry_date,
    vm.dpastate AS dpa_status,
    vm.sccstate AS scc_status,
    vm.bcrstate AS bcr_status,
    vm.docustate AS documentation_completeness,
    vm.polcomp AS policy_compliance,
    vm.proccomp AS procedure_compliance,
    vm.trainstate AS training_status,
    vm.certstate AS certification_status,
    vm.monstate AS monitoring_status,
    vm.repstate AS reporting_status,
    vm.stakecomm AS stakeholder_communication,
    ac.audtrailstate AS audit_status,
    ac.findtally AS audit_findings_count,
    ac.critfindnum AS critical_findings_count,
    ac.remedstate AS remediation_status,
    ac.remeddue AS remediation_due_date,
    ac.authnotify AS authority_notification_status,
    ac.bordermech AS cross_border_mechanism,
    ac.transimpassess AS transfer_impact_assessment,
    ac.localreqs AS local_requirements_status,
    ac.datamapstate AS data_mapping_status,
    ac.sysintstate AS system_integration_status,
    ac.accreqnum AS access_requests_count,
    ac.delreqnum AS deletion_requests_count,
    ac.rectreqnum AS rectification_requests_count,
    ac.portreqnum AS portability_requests_count,
    ac.resptimeday AS response_time_days
FROM 
    dataflow df
JOIN 
    auditandcompliance ac ON df.recordregistry = ac.recordregistry
JOIN 
    vendormanagement vm ON ac.vendjoin = vm.vendortrace
WHERE 
    ac.localreqs = 'Not Met';

WHERE 
    ac.localreqs = 'Not Met';
